title: Sam Donahue as a leader
summary: Donahue is amiable, a fine musician who loved his men.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: What was Sam Donahue like as a leader?

Sam was great. He was one – he was probably the most amiable bandleader anywhere. First of all, he played – he was a fine musician. He wrote well. Played tenor. He played trumpet. He loved all the guys. He loved the guys, and he was one of the boys. It was just great. Such a nice guy. I think about some of those things, how lucky I have been to have been in the company of these guys, people like that.
